title: Your First Weekend at College of the Holy Cross, Shared as Cards
description: Navigate your first days on Mount St. James with this sequence of essential campus spots and orientation traditions.

cards.title: Arrive at Mount St. James
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide tradition
cards.notes: Experience the tradition where upperclassmen volunteers help carry all your belongings into your residence hall room.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming tradition where student volunteers assist new arrivals with their luggage.
cards.evidence_claim: New students experience a tradition where older students volunteer to help them bring belongings into their dorm rooms.
cards.source_title: What Are Some Traditions at the College of the Holy Cross?
cards.access_notes: Occurs on the designated first-year move-in Wednesday in August.

cards.title: First Meal at Kimball
cards.subtitle: The Hill's central dining hall
cards.notes: Visit this historic all-you-care-to-eat hall for your first campus meal; don't miss the signature housemade donuts on Fridays.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall offering a variety of food stations in a classic collegiate setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Kimball Main Dining Room offers all-you-care-to-eat service and signature housemade donuts every Friday.
cards.source_title: Kimball Main Dining Room | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend brunch typically starts at 10:00 AM.

cards.title: Relax on the Hoval
cards.subtitle: Hogan Courtyard
cards.notes: Gather at this oval-shaped courtyard for outdoor events or to enjoy the view of the Worcester skyline.
cards.short_summary: An iconic oval-shaped green space used for student gatherings and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hoval, or Hogan Courtyard, is a popular spot for outdoor gatherings and campus events with views of the Worcester skyline.
cards.source_title: Webcams | College of the Holy Cross

cards.title: Late Night at Cool Beans
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center coffee shop
cards.notes: Grab a late-night milkshake or smoothie at this social hub, open until 11:00 PM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop known for breakfast sandwiches, smoothies, and late-night milkshakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cool Beans is open until 11 PM on Saturdays and Sundays and offers smoothies and milkshakes.
cards.source_title: Cool Beans | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily during the academic year.

cards.title: Visit the Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: The spiritual heart of campus
cards.notes: Explore this century-old architectural landmark, which hosts Sunday evening Mass at 7:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: A historic chapel dedicated to alumni lost in wars, serving as a center for worship and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel hosts Sunday Mass at 7:30 PM when classes are in session.
cards.source_title: St. Joseph Memorial Chapel | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open for visitors and scheduled services; Sunday evening Mass is a popular student time.

cards.title: Join Gateways Sessions
cards.subtitle: New student transition program
cards.notes: Participate in your first-year orientation sessions to meet your classmates and learn about campus life.
cards.short_summary: The mandatory orientation program for all incoming students to facilitate their transition to college.
cards.evidence_claim: All new students participate in Gateways Orientation to settle into campus and make connections.
cards.source_title: Orientation | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students during the first week of arrival.

cards.title: Explore Historic Fenwick
cards.subtitle: The heart of Holy Cross
cards.notes: Walk through the oldest building on campus, rebuilt in 1853, which houses administrative offices and classrooms.
cards.short_summary: The foundational building of the college, named after founder Bishop Benedict Joseph Fenwick.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick Hall is the second-oldest building on campus and is described as the heart of Holy Cross.
cards.source_title: Fenwick Hall: Changes and Trials by Fire
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic and administrative hours.

cards.entity_name: Hart Center at the Luth Athletic Complex
cards.title: Visit the Hart Center
cards.subtitle: Athletics and recreation hub
cards.notes: Check out the fitness facilities or catch a game at this renovated complex overlooking the city.
cards.short_summary: The primary athletic facility on campus, housing a basketball arena, hockey rink, and pool.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hart Center at the Luth Athletic Complex serves as the centerpiece for athletics and recreation at Holy Cross.
cards.source_title: Hart Center at the Luth Athletic Complex - Facilities
cards.access_notes: Student access requires a valid Crusader Card.

cards.title: Celebrate at Mulledy Beach
cards.subtitle: Welcome weekend event
cards.notes: Join the late-night celebration featuring obstacle courses, music, and ice cream on the lawn.
cards.short_summary: An annual orientation event held on the Mulledy Beach lawn to welcome new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The First Night Celebration at Mulledy Beach features an adrenaline obstacle course, DJ, and ice cream.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Events - Holy Cross Magazine
cards.access_notes: Typically held from 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM on the first Saturday of the semester.

cards.title: Play in the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Hogan Ground Floor
cards.notes: Head to the bottom floor of the campus center to find the game room and lounge area for weekend downtime.
cards.short_summary: A recreational space for students located on the lower level of the main campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: The bottom floor of the Hogan Campus Center houses a game room and lounge area.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Hogan Campus Center operating hours.
